exercises.instructionEn: Rewrite the sentences in the negative and interrogative, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni inkor va so'roq shaklida qayta yozing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
30-betdagi 2-mashqning davomi (7–9 bandlar).

ESLATMA:
  INKOR:  'be' fe'liga NOT qo'shiladi → isn't / aren't / 'm not
  SO'ROQ: 'be' fe'li EGADAN OLDINGA chiqadi
  Asosiy fe'l (-ing bilan) O'ZGARMAYDI.

items.textEn: 7  He is sunbathing. — INKOR:
items.whyUz:
'he' → IS → ISN'T.
'sunbathe' → 'sunbathing' (-e tushdi).

items.textEn: 7  He is sunbathing. — SO'ROQ:
items.whyUz: 'Is he ...?' — javob: Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.

items.textEn: 8  They are listening to music. — INKOR:
items.whyUz:
Ko'plik ega → ARE → AREN'T.
'listen TO music' — 'to' predlogi shart.

items.textEn: 8  They are listening to music. — SO'ROQ:
items.whyUz: 'Are they ...?' — javob: Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.

items.textEn: 9  We are swimming. — INKOR:
items.whyUz:
'we' → ARE → AREN'T.
'swim' → 'swimming' (m ikkilandi).

items.textEn: 9  We are swimming. — SO'ROQ:
items.whyUz: 'Are we ...?' — javob: Yes, we are. / No, we aren't.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures, then use the verbs in the list to make sentences, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang, so'ng ro'yxatdagi fe'llardan foydalanib gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: read, play, wear, paint, dance, wash

OLTI RASM:
  1 — keng kovboy shlyapasi kiygan erkak
  2 — molbertda rasm chizayotgan sariq ko'ylakdagi ayol
  3 — mashinani shlang bilan yuvayotgan ayol
  4 — birga katta kitob o'qiyotgan yigit va qiz
  5 — kursida o'tirib gitara chalayotgan yigit
  6 — qo'l ushlashib raqsga tushayotgan er-xotin

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA: 1  He IS WEARING a hat.

QOLIP: ega + is/are + fe'l-ING + to'ldiruvchi.

items.whyUz: Kitobda BERILGAN namuna. 'wear' → 'wearing' (oddiy -ing).

items.textEn: 2  She ............ a picture.
items.whyUz:
'to paint a picture' = rasm chizmoq (bo'yoq bilan).
'paint' → 'painting' (oddiy -ing).
Birlik ega → IS.

'to wash the car' = mashinani yuvmoq.
'wash' → 'washing' (oddiy -ing).

Ko'plik ega → ARE.
'read' → 'reading' (oddiy -ing).

items.textEn: 5  He ............ the guitar.
items.whyUz:
'play THE guitar' — cholg'u asbobi oldida THE shart.
'play' → 'playing' (oddiy -ing).

Ko'plik ega → ARE.
'dance' → 'dancing' (-e TUSHDI).

exercises.instructionEn: Write short answers to the questions, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  A: Is he sleeping?
  B: No, he isn't.

QISQA JAVOB QOIDASI:
  Yes / No + EGA OLMOSHI + 'be' fe'li
  Asosiy fe'l (-ing bilan) TAKRORLANMAYDI.

TASDIQDA QISQARTMA YO'Q:
  TO'G'RI: Yes, he is.     XATO: Yes, he's.
  TO'G'RI: Yes, they are.  XATO: Yes, they're.

INKORDA QISQARTMA BOR:
  No, he isn't.  No, they aren't.  No, I'm not.

DIQQAT — 'Are you ...?' SAVOLIGA JAVOB:
  Savol SIZGA qaratilgan → javobda 'I' yoki 'WE'.
  'Yes, you are' XATO bo'ladi (siz o'zingiz haqingizda gapirasiz).

items.textEn: 1  A: Is he sleeping?  B: No, ............
items.whyUz: Kitobda BERILGAN namuna. 'Is he ...?' → 'he isn't'.

items.textEn: 2  A: Are they watching TV?  B: Yes, ............
items.whyUz:
'Are they ...?' → 'Yes, they are.'
'Yes, they're' XATO.

items.textEn: 3  A: Is she driving a car?  B: No, ............
items.whyUz: 'Is she ...?' → 'No, she isn't.'

items.textEn: 4  A: Are you listening to music?  B: Yes, ............
items.whyUz:
'Are YOU ...?' → javobda 'I' ishlatiladi: 'Yes, I am.'
'Yes, you are' XATO.
'Yes, I'm' ham XATO — tasdiqda qisqartma yo'q.

items.textEn: 5  A: Are we playing the violin?  B: No, ............
items.whyUz:
'Are WE ...?' → 'No, we aren't.'
'a violin' = skripka.

items.textEn: 6  A: Is it snowing today?  B: Yes, ............
items.whyUz:
'Is IT ...?' → 'Yes, it is.'
'Yes, it's' XATO.

items.textEn: 7  A: Are you playing computer games?  B: No, ............
items.whyUz:
'Are YOU ...?' → 'No, I'm not.'
'I amn't' — YO'Q shakl.

items.textEn: 8  A: Is he wearing a jumper?  B: Yes, ............
items.whyUz:
'Is he ...?' → 'Yes, he is.'
'a jumper' = jemper, sviter (britancha; amerikacha 'a sweater').

items.textEn: 9  A: Are they picking flowers?  B: No, ............
items.whyUz:
'Are they ...?' → 'No, they aren't.'
'to pick flowers' = gul termoq (Coursebook 48-bet).

items.textEn: 10  A: Are we going to the beach?  B: Yes, ............
items.whyUz:
'Are WE ...?' → 'Yes, we are.'
'go TO the beach' — 'to' predlogi shart.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple or present continuous.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni present simple yoki present continuous shakliga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
QAYSI ZAMONNI TANLASH — VAQT SO'ZIGA QARANG:

  PRESENT SIMPLE (odat, doimiy holat):
     usually, always, often, sometimes, never,
     every day / every Sunday / every afternoon,
     in her free time, in the summer

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS (hozir sodir bo'layotgan ish):
     now, at the moment, at present, today

PRESENT SIMPLE YASALISHI:
  I / you / we / they  → fe'l (asos shakli)
  he / she / it        → fe'l + S

  -s QO'SHISH QOIDALARI:
     oddiy:                wake up → wakes up
     -ch, -sh, -s, -x, -o: watch → watches;  go → goes
     undosh + y:           study → studies

PRESENT CONTINUOUS YASALISHI:
  ega + am/is/are + fe'l-ING

items.textEn: 1  Jim usually ............ (wake up) late on Sundays.
items.whyUz:
'usually' → PRESENT SIMPLE (odat).
'Jim' — birlik 3-shaxs → fe'lga -S: wakeS up.
'to wake up' = uyg'onmoq.

items.textEn: 2  I ............ (play) tennis at the moment.
items.whyUz:
'at the moment' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS (hozir).
'I' → AM + playing.

items.textEn: 3  Sheila ............ (listen) to music in her free time.
items.hintUz: 'in her free time' — odatmi yoki hozirmi?
items.whyUz:
'in her free time' = bo'sh vaqtida — bu ODAT → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'Sheila' — birlik 3-shaxs → listenS.

items.textEn: 4  The sun usually ............ (shine) in the summer.
items.whyUz:
'usually' + 'in the summer' → PRESENT SIMPLE (doimiy holat).
'the sun' — birlik → shineS.

items.textEn: 5  We ............ (make) a snowman at the moment.
items.whyUz:
'at the moment' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'we' → ARE + making ('make' dagi -e TUSHDI).

items.textEn: 6  The children ............ (swim) now.
items.whyUz:
'now' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'the children' — ko'plik → ARE + swimming (m IKKILANDI).

items.textEn: 7  She ............ (go) on a picnic every Sunday.
items.whyUz:
'every Sunday' → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'she' → goES (-o bilan tugagani uchun -ES).

items.textEn: 8  Bill ............ (have) a shower at the moment.
items.whyUz:
'at the moment' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'Bill' — birlik → IS + having ('have' dagi -e TUSHDI).
DIQQAT: 'have a shower' (dush qabul qilmoq) — HARAKAT,
shuning uchun -ing shakli mumkin.
'have' EGALIK ma'nosida bo'lsa -ing OLMAYDI:
'I am having a car' XATO.

items.textEn: 9  They ............ (decorate) the Christmas tree now.
items.whyUz:
'now' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'they' → ARE + decorating (-e TUSHDI).

items.textEn: 10  Joy ............ (watch) TV every afternoon.
items.whyUz:
'every afternoon' → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'Joy' — birlik 3-shaxs → watchES (-ch bilan tugagani uchun -ES).

items.textEn: 11  They ............ (sleep) at the moment.
items.whyUz:
'at the moment' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'they' → ARE + sleeping (oddiy -ing).

groups.explanationUz: Har biri uchun qaysi qoida ishlaganini ko'ring.

groups.ruleUz: 'have' — ikki xil ma'no, ikki xil qoida
groups.explanationUz: Ma'nosiga qarab -ing shakli mumkin yoki mumkin emas.
'play' fe'li cholg'u asbobi bilan kelsa, oldiga THE qo'yiladi.

patterns.exampleEn: He is wearing a hat. They are dancing.
patterns.exampleUz: U shlyapa kiygan. Ular raqsga tushishayapti.
patterns.explanationUz: Rasmdagi manzarani tasvirlash uchun asosiy qolip.

patterns.exampleEn: Is he sleeping? — No, he isn't. Are they watching TV? — Yes, they are.
patterns.exampleUz: U uxlayaptimi? — Yo'q. Ular televizor ko'rishayaptimi? — Ha.
patterns.explanationUz: Tasdiqda qisqartma YO'Q: 'Yes, he is' ('Yes, he's' XATO).

patterns.formula: Are YOU ...? — Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
patterns.exampleEn: Are you listening to music? — Yes, I am.
Jim usually wakes up late on Sundays. Joy watches TV every afternoon.
patterns.exampleUz: Jim odatda yakshanba kunlari kech uyg'onadi. Joy har kuni tushdan keyin televizor ko'radi.
patterns.explanationUz: Odat va kundalik tartib → Present Simple.

patterns.formula: now / at the moment + Present Continuous
patterns.exampleEn: We are making a snowman at the moment. The children are swimming now.
patterns.exampleUz: Biz hozir qorbobo yasayapmiz. Bolalar hozir suzishayapti.
patterns.explanationUz: Hozir sodir bo'layotgan ish → Present Continuous.

patterns.formula: have a shower / have breakfast — HARAKAT, -ing mumkin.
patterns.exampleEn: Bill is having a shower at the moment.
patterns.explanationUz:
'have' EGALIK ma'nosida bo'lsa -ing OLMAYDI:
'I am having a car' XATO.
